# usbip-win2 installer

The unmodified `USBip-0.9.8.1-x64.exe` is from the [usbip-win2 0.9.8.1 release](https://github.com/vadimgrn/usbip-win2/releases/tag/v.0.9.8.1). Its SHA-256 is `38cad6d4432b52d5bb9409d9ad03b72fdffc4ada4cd3a48fbeca1a2752a8518a`. The file had a valid Authenticode signature from Cloudyne Systems (Scheibling Consulting AB) during verification on 2026-11-17.

The project is BSD-2-Clause licensed; see [LICENSE.txt](LICENSE.txt). PadBridge extracts this installer when USB/IP is missing and runs it only after a user click. The upstream installer may restart USB hubs during installation.
